title.es: Insistir, escalar y cerrar el asunto

es: Reconocer las jugadas de un hilo de correos de reclamación (chase, escalate, acknowledge, close the loop), distinguir su tono e inferir la actitud del remitente.

vocabulary.es: escalar, subir a un nivel superior
cerrar el asunto e informar del final
pasarse por alto, perderse por el camino

teaching.en: I am writing to chase the outstanding refund, since nobody has replied to either of the two messages I sent last month.
teaching.es: Escribo para reclamar el reembolso pendiente, ya que nadie ha respondido a ninguno de los dos mensajes que envié el mes pasado.
teaching.explanationEs: Chase + lo pendiente: es la primera jugada, neutra y cortés. Outstanding describe lo que aún se debe o falta por hacer.
segments: I am writing to chase the outstanding refund, since nobody has
replied to either of the two messages I sent last month.
teaching.audioText: I am writing to chase the outstanding refund, since nobody has replied to either of the two messages I sent last month.

teaching.en: As a gentle reminder, the repair is still unresolved, and I would appreciate an update before the end of this week.
teaching.es: Como recordatorio amable, la reparación sigue sin resolverse y agradecería una novedad antes de que termine esta semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Reminder con gentle suaviza el segundo aviso; unresolved explica por qué insistes.
segments: As a gentle reminder, the repair is still unresolved, and I
would appreciate an update before the end of this week.
teaching.audioText: As a gentle reminder, the repair is still unresolved, and I would appreciate an update before the end of this week.

teaching.en: If the matter is not solved by Friday, I will have no choice but to escalate it to a senior manager.
teaching.es: Si el asunto no se resuelve para el viernes, no tendré más remedio que escalarlo a un directivo de rango superior.
teaching.explanationEs: Escalate it to + persona con autoridad. Es una jugada firme: se usa después de un recordatorio, no antes.
segments: If the matter is not solved by Friday, I will have
no choice but to escalate it to a senior manager.
teaching.audioText: If the matter is not solved by Friday, I will have no choice but to escalate it to a senior manager.

teaching.en: Please acknowledge receipt of this message, because I would hate for my complaint to fall through the cracks.
teaching.es: Por favor, acuse recibo de este mensaje, porque no quisiera que mi queja se pierda por el camino.
teaching.explanationEs: Acknowledge receipt pide confirmar que el mensaje llegó; fall through the cracks es lo que se pasa por alto entre departamentos.
segments: Please acknowledge receipt of this message, because I would
hate for my complaint to fall through the cracks.
teaching.audioText: Please acknowledge receipt of this message, because I would hate for my complaint to fall through the cracks.

teaching.en: I will copy in a senior colleague, who can confirm that the payment was never received by your accounts team.
teaching.es: Pondré en copia a un compañero de rango superior, que puede confirmar que su equipo de contabilidad nunca recibió el pago.
teaching.explanationEs: Copy in es una forma moderada de escalar: alguien con autoridad ve el hilo, pero el tono sigue siendo profesional.
segments: I will copy in a senior colleague, who can confirm
that the payment was never received by your accounts team.
teaching.audioText: I will copy in a senior colleague, who can confirm that the payment was never received by your accounts team.

teaching.en: Just to close the loop, the engineer came on Tuesday and fixed the fault, so I consider the matter closed.
teaching.es: Solo para cerrar el asunto: el técnico vino el martes y arregló la avería, así que doy el asunto por zanjado.
teaching.explanationEs: Close the loop: avisas del resultado a quien siguió el caso, y el hilo termina de forma cordial.
segments: Just to close the loop, the engineer came on Tuesday
and fixed the fault, so I consider the matter closed.
teaching.audioText: Just to close the loop, the engineer came on Tuesday and fixed the fault, so I consider the matter closed.

prompt.es: Clasifica el correo: ¿qué jugada hace en el hilo?

choices.text: It escalates the case to someone higher up.
It chases an unanswered request without raising the tone.
It closes the case and thanks the company for the refund.

feedback.es: El correo recuerda un mensaje sin respuesta y pide una novedad sobre lo pendiente, sin amenazar ni agradecer: es una jugada de recordatorio.

hint.es: Busca qué recuerda el remitente y si amenaza con subir el asunto.

origin.text: Dear Mr Hale, I am writing to follow up on my email of 3 March, which remains unanswered. The outstanding refund of £89 has still not reached my account, and I would be grateful for an update this week.

prompt.es: Completa: «Si no tengo noticias el viernes, lo escalaré a un directivo.»

feedback.es: Escalate it to + persona es la colocación para subir un asunto a alguien con más autoridad cuando no hay respuesta.

hint.es: Es el verbo que significa subir el asunto a un nivel superior.

origin.text: Nobody has answered my two emails, and the matter is still unresolved. If I hear nothing by Friday, I will ___ it to a senior manager.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Acuse recibo para que este mensaje no se pierda por el camino.»

answer.text: Please acknowledge receipt so this message does not fall through the cracks

feedback.es: Acknowledge receipt pide confirmación de llegada, y fall through the cracks expresa el riesgo de que el mensaje se pierda.

hint.es: Empieza por please acknowledge y termina con la expresión del riesgo.

prompt.es: Escucha la historia y elige qué hizo Carlos antes de avisar de que escalaría.

choices.text: He phoned a senior manager at the company to ask for a bigger discount.
He thanked the company for its apology and the new date.
He sent a short reminder after his first email got no answer.

feedback.es: Primero escribió para reclamar, después envió un recordatorio breve y solo entonces puso en copia a un directivo; el agradecimiento llegó al final.

origin.audio: Last month, Carlos ordered a table online. Three weeks later, nothing had arrived, so he wrote to the company to chase the order. When nobody answered, he sent a short reminder, and ten days after that he copied in a senior manager and warned that he would escalate the matter. The next morning, an apology arrived, together with a delivery date and a discount, and Carlos replied with a brief thank-you to close the loop.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase del hilo con la jugada que hace.

pairs: I have copied in our senior manager on this message.
This is a gentle reminder about my outstanding refund.
Thank you for confirming the new appointment for Monday.
Just to close the loop, the new part works perfectly.

feedback.es: Poner en copia a un superior sube el nivel; un recordatorio amable insiste sobre lo pendiente; agradecer una cita confirma; informar de que todo funciona cierra el asunto.

pairs: I have copied in our senior manager on this message.
This is a gentle reminder about my outstanding refund.
Thank you for confirming the new appointment for Monday.
Just to close the loop, the new part works perfectly.

prompt.es: Lee el mensaje. ¿Qué efecto busca «I am sure this is just a mistake»?

choices.text: Soften the reminder by assuming there was no bad intention.
Warn Sara that the case will soon go to her manager.
Blame Sara for forgetting the refund on purpose.

feedback.es: La frase supone que el retraso es un error y no mala fe: suaviza el recordatorio sin renunciar a pedir la revisión del reembolso.

origin.text: Hi Sara, I am sure this is just a mistake, but my refund is still outstanding. Could you take another look at it? I would hate for it to fall through the cracks, and I am happy to send the receipt again.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de voz y elige qué hará la clienta si no hay respuesta.

choices.text: Cancel her order and ask for a new delivery date.
Take the case further if nothing arrives by Friday.
Write a third email and copy in her own manager.

feedback.es: Sara fija el viernes como límite y avisa de que llevará el caso más lejos si no recibe respuesta; no cancela ni escribe un tercer correo.

origin.audio: Good morning, this is Sara Vega calling about my order from the third of March. I wrote to your team on the third and again a week later, and I still have no reply. I do not want to escalate this, but the refund has been outstanding for a month, and a senior colleague of yours is already copied in on my last email. If I hear nothing by Friday, I will take the case further. I would much prefer to sort it out with you directly.

prompt.es: Escucha otra vez: ¿qué da a entender Sara con «I do not want to escalate this»?

choices.text: She has lost interest in the refund after such a long delay.
She already considers the matter closed and wants to stop.
She would rather solve it directly, but she is ready to act.

feedback.es: La frase muestra reticencia, no indiferencia: prefiere arreglarlo con la empresa, pero la advertencia final deja claro que actuará.

origin.audio: Good morning, this is Sara Vega calling about my order from the third of March. I wrote to your team on the third and again a week later, and I still have no reply. I do not want to escalate this, but the refund has been outstanding for a month, and a senior colleague of yours is already copied in on my last email. If I hear nothing by Friday, I will take the case further. I would much prefer to sort it out with you directly.

prompt.es: Lee la respuesta de la empresa. ¿Qué pretende con «I hope this closes the matter»?

choices.text: Invite him to consider the case finished, leaving the door open.
Ask him to chase again next week if nothing has arrived by then.
Warn him that the company will escalate the case itself.

feedback.es: La empresa da el caso por cerrado pero añade que puede volver a escribir: propone cerrar el asunto sin cerrar la puerta.

origin.text: Dear Mr Patel, thank you for your patience. Your replacement will arrive on Thursday, and I apologise that your first email was missed during our busy season. I have also added a discount to your next order. I hope this closes the matter, but please write again if anything is still unclear.

prompt.es: Completa: «Lamento que su mensaje se perdiera por el camino.»

feedback.es: Fall through the cracks es la expresión fija para algo que se pierde o se pasa por alto dentro de una organización.

origin.text: I am sorry that your message fell through the ___ during the move to our new system. I have now passed your case to a senior colleague.

prompt.es: Lee el correo. ¿Qué da a entender la clienta al poner en copia a la directora?

choices.text: That she has already accepted the long delay and does not blame the company.
That she is ready to go higher if the silence continues.
That she wants the director to apologise in person.

feedback.es: Copiar a la directora tras dos mensajes sin respuesta sube el nivel del hilo: avisa de que está dispuesta a llegar más arriba si sigue el silencio.

origin.text: Dear Ms Ortiz, I wrote on 2 May and again on 16 May, and I am afraid both messages remain without an answer. The matter is now unresolved after six weeks. I have therefore copied in your director, and I would be grateful for a reply by Friday.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué jugada hace la empresa en este mensaje.

choices.text: It closes the case because the fault has been fixed.
It chases the customer for an outstanding payment.
It acknowledges the complaint and promises a follow-up.

feedback.es: La empresa acusa recibo, se disculpa y promete un mensaje posterior el viernes; aún no cierra el caso porque la avería no está confirmada.

origin.audio: Thank you for your email, which we received this morning. We are sorry that your first message went unanswered. An engineer will call you tomorrow, and we will write again on Friday to confirm that the fault has been fixed.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Solo para cerrar el asunto: el técnico ya arregló la avería.»

answer.text: Just to close the loop the engineer has fixed the fault

feedback.es: Just to close the loop abre el mensaje final que informa del resultado a quien siguió el caso.

es: Redactar recordatorios y reclamos firmes pero corteses con fórmulas de seguimiento y suavizadores escritos, evitar el tono seco y repasar el causativo have + objeto + participio.

teaching.en: A message that simply says «Reply today» can come across as curt, even when the writer is only in a hurry.
teaching.es: Un mensaje que solo dice «Responda hoy» puede parecer seco, aunque quien escribe solo tenga prisa.
teaching.explanationEs: Curt describe un tono demasiado breve y poco cortés. La solución no es quitar la petición, sino envolverla mejor.
segments: A message that simply says «Reply today» can come across as
curt, even when the writer is only in a hurry.
teaching.audioText: A message that simply says «Reply today» can come across as curt, even when the writer is only in a hurry.

teaching.en: I am just following up on my request, and I would be grateful if you could kindly send me an update by Friday.
teaching.es: Solo quería dar seguimiento a mi solicitud, y le agradecería que pudiera enviarme amablemente una novedad antes del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: Just y kindly suavizan el recordatorio; I would be grateful if you could + verbo + plazo pide con firmeza y cortesía.
segments: I am just following up on my request, and I would be
grateful if you could kindly send me an update by Friday.
teaching.audioText: I am just following up on my request, and I would be grateful if you could kindly send me an update by Friday.

teaching.en: I am afraid I have not yet received the part, and I would like to reiterate that I need it no later than Monday.
teaching.es: Me temo que todavía no he recibido la pieza, y quisiera reiterar que la necesito a más tardar el lunes.
teaching.explanationEs: I am afraid suaviza la mala noticia; reiterate repite una petición sin repetir el reproche; no later than fija el límite.
segments: I am afraid I have not yet received the part, and I
would like to reiterate that I need it no later than Monday.
teaching.audioText: I am afraid I have not yet received the part, and I would like to reiterate that I need it no later than Monday.

teaching.en: Please reply at your earliest convenience, and in any case no later than Monday, as the deadline is firm.
teaching.es: Por favor, responda en cuanto le sea posible y, en todo caso, a más tardar el lunes, ya que el plazo es firme.
teaching.explanationEs: At your earliest convenience es suave; in any case + fecha marca el límite que no se mueve.
segments: Please reply at your earliest convenience, and in any case
no later than Monday, as the deadline is firm.
teaching.audioText: Please reply at your earliest convenience, and in any case no later than Monday, as the deadline is firm.

teaching.en: We would be grateful to have the car repaired by Friday, as a swift repair would make a real difference for us.
teaching.es: Agradeceríamos que el coche estuviera reparado para el viernes, ya que una reparación rápida nos ayudaría mucho.
teaching.explanationEs: Have + objeto + participio pide que lo haga otra persona. Swift describe una respuesta o una solución rápida.
segments: We would be grateful to have the car repaired by Friday,
as a swift repair would make a real difference for us.
teaching.audioText: We would be grateful to have the car repaired by Friday, as a swift repair would make a real difference for us.

teaching.en: I understand that the delay was not your fault, but I must remain firm about Friday, and I look forward to hearing from you.
teaching.es: Entiendo que el retraso no fue culpa suya, pero debo mantenerme firme con el viernes, y espero su respuesta.
teaching.explanationEs: Comprender y mantenerse firme van juntos: baja el tono, no el plazo. Look forward to va seguido de -ing.
segments: I understand that the delay was not your fault, but I must
remain firm about Friday, and I look forward to hearing from you.
teaching.audioText: I understand that the delay was not your fault, but I must remain firm about Friday, and I look forward to hearing from you.

prompt.es: Elige la versión firme y cortés de este borrador brusco.

choices.text: I am sorry to bother you, but it does not matter if the part comes at some point, whenever you can manage it.
I would be grateful if you could send the part now, because I am tired of waiting and I may complain.
I am afraid I have not yet received the part, so I would be grateful if you could send it by Friday.

feedback.es: Esa versión da un hecho, pide con cortesía y fija un plazo; las otras renuncian al plazo o mantienen el reproche y la amenaza.

hint.es: Busca la opción que conserva el plazo pero quita el reproche y la amenaza.

origin.text: Blunt draft: «You still have not sent the part. Send it now. I am tired of waiting, and I will complain.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Agradeceríamos que el coche estuviera reparado para el viernes.»

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (have it repaired) expresa que otra persona hace la reparación.

hint.es: Después del objeto it va el participio del verbo repair.

origin.text: The garage has already kept our car for a week. We would be grateful to have it ___ by Friday, as we need it for work.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Le agradecería que respondiera a más tardar el lunes.»

answer.text: I would be grateful if you could reply no later than Monday

feedback.es: I would be grateful if you could + verbo + no later than + día es la petición cortés con plazo.

hint.es: Empieza por la fórmula de gratitud y termina con el límite.

prompt.es: Según el correo, ¿qué parte del mensaje no se suaviza?

choices.text: The Monday deadline for the part, which stays fixed.
The request for a date, which is only a suggestion.
The hope that the writer is not a nuisance to the team.

feedback.es: Las fórmulas amables suavizan el tono, pero el remitente dice que debe mantenerse firme con el plazo del lunes.

origin.text: Dear Mr Lane, I hope you are well. I am just following up on my request of 4 March for a replacement part, and I am afraid I have not yet received an update. I understand that your team is busy, and I do not wish to be a nuisance, but I must remain firm about the deadline: the part is needed no later than Monday, as the machine is essential to my work. I would be grateful if you could kindly confirm the date.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con lo que consigue en el correo.

pairs: Could you kindly send me an update?
I am afraid I have not yet received the part.

pairs.es: da una mala noticia sin reprochar

pairs: Please reply at your earliest convenience.

pairs.es: deja margen de tiempo al lector

pairs: I look forward to hearing from you by Friday.

feedback.es: Kindly suaviza la petición; I am afraid presenta un hecho sin reproche; at your earliest convenience da margen; look forward to cierra con expectativa.

pairs: Could you kindly send me an update?
I am afraid I have not yet received the part.

pairs.es: da una mala noticia sin reprochar

pairs: Please reply at your earliest convenience.

pairs.es: deja margen de tiempo al lector

pairs: I look forward to hearing from you by Friday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Debo reiterar que la reparación tiene que estar lista el viernes.»

feedback.es: Reiterate repite una petición con firmeza y sin agresividad: es más formal y menos brusco que repeat.

origin.text: I understand that the workshop is busy, and I appreciate your help so far, but I must ___ that the repair has to be finished by Friday.

prompt.es: Lee el correo. ¿Qué actitud transmite Mia con «I am afraid» y «I understand»?

choices.text: Ready to cancel the order and looking for an excuse.
Resigned to the delay and not wanting to insist further.
Annoyed, but hiding a threat behind polite words.
Firm about the date, but considerate towards the supplier.

feedback.es: Mia reconoce la dificultad del proveedor, pero pide adelantar la fecha y pide una respuesta pronta para buscar otra solución: firme y considerada.

origin.text: Dear Mr Ward, thank you for your quick reply. I am afraid the new delivery date of 20 June is too late for us. I would be grateful if you could bring it forward, and I understand that this may not be easy. If it is not possible, please tell me at your earliest convenience so that we can plan something else.

prompt.es: Completa: «Entiendo el retraso, pero debo mantenerme firme con la fecha.»

feedback.es: Remain firm es la colocación que combina comprensión con firmeza; firm es adjetivo y necesita un verbo copulativo.

origin.text: Thank you for explaining why the parcel is late. I understand the delay, but I must ___ firm about the date, because the event cannot be moved.

prompt.es: Reescribe con firmeza y cortesía: pide el pedido antes del lunes.

answer.text: I am afraid I have not yet received my order, and I would be grateful if you could kindly send it no later than Monday. I understand that your team is busy, but I must remain firm about the date. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
accepted: I am afraid I have not yet received my order, and I would be grateful if you could kindly send it no later than Monday. I understand that your team is busy, but I must remain firm about the date. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
Could you kindly send me my order before Monday? I am afraid it is already late, and I must remain firm about the date. I would appreciate an update, and I look forward to your reply.

feedback.es: Una buena reescritura mantiene el plazo del lunes, cambia la orden por una fórmula cortés y cierra esperando respuesta, sin insultos ni amenazas.

origin.text: Borrador brusco: «Your team is useless. Send my order now, or I will complain to your boss.» Reescríbelo en inglés con firmeza y cortesía: una fórmula de petición, un suavizador, el plazo (a más tardar el lunes) y un cierre que espere respuesta (de 35 a 60 palabras).

prompt.es: Lee el contexto. ¿Qué frase expresa lo que Carlos pide al taller?

choices.text: We would be grateful to check the brakes ourselves by Thursday.
We would be grateful to have checked the brakes by Thursday.
We would be grateful to have the brakes checked by Thursday.

feedback.es: Have + objeto + participio (have the brakes checked) pide que otra persona haga el trabajo; las otras opciones dicen que lo haría el propio Carlos.

origin.text: Carlos cannot repair his own car, so he writes to the garage: the brakes have been making a noise for a week, and the car must be ready to drive on Friday. He wants the garage to do the work before then.

prompt.es: Lee la respuesta de la empresa. ¿Qué echa en falta la clienta?

choices.text: A firm date for when the part will be sent.
An apology for the delay in answering her.
A reason why the part has not arrived yet.

feedback.es: La empresa promete esfuerzo y «soon», pero no da ninguna fecha concreta: es lo que la clienta, que necesita un plazo, echa en falta.

origin.text: Dear Ms Hart, thank you for your patience. We are doing our best to find the part, and we hope to send it soon. Please be patient while we look into the matter, and do not hesitate to write again if you have any further questions.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me temo que aún no he recibido una respuesta.»

answer.text: I am afraid I have not yet received a reply

feedback.es: I am afraid + oración completa da la mala noticia como un hecho y no como un reproche.

prompt.es: Completa: «Su mensaje pareció seco, aunque usted no quisiera ser descortés.»

feedback.es: Curt describe un mensaje demasiado breve y seco; come across as indica la impresión que causa, no la intención.

origin.text: Your message was only two lines long, and it came across as ___ even though you did not mean to be rude.

title.es: Leer una cadena de correos de servicio

es: Comprender una cadena de tres correos sobre una reparación, localizar el problema, el plazo y la solución acordada, e inferir lo que cada parte da a entender.

teaching.en: The customer reports that the washing machine has a leak, which began only days after the engineer replaced a faulty part.
teaching.es: La clienta informa de que la lavadora tiene una fuga, que empezó solo unos días después de que el técnico cambiara una pieza defectuosa.
teaching.explanationEs: El primer correo suele contener el problema: qué falla, desde cuándo y qué ocurrió antes.
segments: The customer reports that the washing machine has a leak, which
began only days after the engineer replaced a faulty part.
teaching.audioText: The customer reports that the washing machine has a leak, which began only days after the engineer replaced a faulty part.

teaching.en: The company replies that an engineer can visit on Monday morning, but the spare part will take a week to arrive by post.
teaching.es: La empresa responde que un técnico puede visitarla el lunes por la mañana, pero que la pieza de repuesto tardará una semana en llegar por correo.
teaching.explanationEs: But introduce una corrección: el plazo de la visita y el plazo de la pieza son dos datos distintos.
segments: The company replies that an engineer can visit on Monday morning, but
the spare part will take a week to arrive by post.
teaching.audioText: The company replies that an engineer can visit on Monday morning, but the spare part will take a week to arrive by post.

teaching.en: As agreed, the company will send the part by courier, and in the meantime the customer should switch the machine off.
teaching.es: Como se acordó, la empresa enviará la pieza por mensajería y, mientras tanto, la clienta debe apagar la máquina.
teaching.explanationEs: As agreed marca la solución acordada; in the meantime añade lo que se hace hasta que llegue.
segments: As agreed, the company will send the part by courier, and
in the meantime the customer should switch the machine off.
teaching.audioText: As agreed, the company will send the part by courier, and in the meantime the customer should switch the machine off.

teaching.en: Because the machine is still under warranty, the repair will be free of charge, and the visit does not count as an extra cost.
teaching.es: Como la máquina sigue en garantía, la reparación será gratuita y la visita no cuenta como un coste adicional.
teaching.explanationEs: La garantía explica por qué no se paga: es la causa, no la solución.
segments: Because the machine is still under warranty, the repair will be free
of charge, and the visit does not count as an extra cost.
teaching.audioText: Because the machine is still under warranty, the repair will be free of charge, and the visit does not count as an extra cost.

teaching.en: When the customer cannot stay at home on Monday, the company offers to reschedule the visit for Wednesday afternoon.
teaching.es: Cuando la clienta no puede quedarse en casa el lunes, la empresa ofrece reprogramar la visita para el miércoles por la tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: Reschedule + la visita + for + nueva fecha: los datos cambian de un correo a otro y manda el último.
segments: When the customer cannot stay at home on Monday, the
company offers to reschedule the visit for Wednesday afternoon.
teaching.audioText: When the customer cannot stay at home on Monday, the company offers to reschedule the visit for Wednesday afternoon.

teaching.en: As a goodwill gesture, the company extends the warranty by six months, although it does not admit that the fault was its mistake.
teaching.es: Como gesto de cortesía comercial, la empresa amplía la garantía seis meses, aunque no admite que la avería fuera culpa suya.
teaching.explanationEs: Un goodwill gesture es una concesión voluntaria: ofrecerla no equivale a admitir la culpa.
segments: As a goodwill gesture, the company extends the warranty by six months,
although it does not admit that the fault was its mistake.
teaching.audioText: As a goodwill gesture, the company extends the warranty by six months, although it does not admit that the fault was its mistake.

prompt.es: Lee el primer correo. ¿Cuál es el problema que describe el cliente?

choices.text: The washing machine is leaking and is still covered by the warranty.
The washing machine has stopped working and is out of warranty.
The washing machine leaks because an engineer repaired it badly.

feedback.es: El cliente describe una fuga desde el martes y aclara que la máquina sigue en garantía; no dice que esté fuera de garantía ni culpa al técnico.

hint.es: Fíjate en qué falla, desde cuándo y si la garantía sigue vigente.

origin.text: Dear Sir or Madam, since Tuesday the washing machine has been leaking water across the kitchen floor. It is still under warranty, so I would like an engineer to visit as soon as possible.

prompt.es: Completa: «Como se acordó, la empresa enviará la pieza por mensajería.»

feedback.es: As agreed introduce la solución acordada: quién hace qué y cómo, según lo hablado antes.

hint.es: Es el participio que introduce lo que las dos partes ya han pactado.

origin.text: The part has to be ordered from abroad. As ___, the company will send it by courier, and the engineer will fit it on Monday.

prompt.es: Ordena: «La reparación es gratuita porque la máquina está en garantía.»

answer.text: The repair is free of charge because the machine is under warranty

feedback.es: Free of charge expresa que no se paga, y because the machine is under warranty da el motivo.

hint.es: Empieza por el sujeto y deja el motivo para el final.

prompt.es: Según el tercer correo, ¿qué cambia el cliente respecto a lo propuesto?

choices.text: The way the part travels, which would now be a courier.
The day of the visit, which would move to Wednesday.
The price of the repair, which would now be free.

feedback.es: El único dato nuevo del tercer correo es la fecha de la visita; el envío por mensajería y la gratuidad ya estaban acordados o cubiertos por la garantía.

origin.text: Email 1: The washing machine has been leaking since Tuesday, and the kitchen floor is wet. It is still under warranty, so could an engineer visit this week? Email 2: We can send an engineer on Monday morning. However, the faulty part has to be ordered, so we will send it by courier, and it may take a week to arrive. Email 3: Monday is difficult for me, so could we move the visit to Wednesday? Please send the part by courier, as you said, free of charge.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje del mensajero y elige qué opciones tiene ahora el cliente.

choices.text: Ask the courier to send the part to a different address.
Cancel the delivery and order a new part from the shop.
Wait for a second delivery or collect the part himself.

feedback.es: El mensajero ofrece volver mañana entre las dos y las cuatro o que el cliente recoja la pieza después del mediodía; no menciona otra dirección ni cancelar.

origin.audio: Hello, this is a message for Mr Brown from the courier. We called at your address this morning, but nobody was in, so the spare part has gone back to our office. We can try again tomorrow between two and four, or you can pick it up yourself after noon.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase del hilo con la función que cumple.

pairs: The machine has been leaking since Tuesday.
An engineer can visit on Monday morning.
As agreed, the part will come by courier.
The warranty covers the repair.

pairs.es: motivo de que no se pague

feedback.es: La fuga es el problema; la visita el lunes es un plazo; As agreed introduce lo pactado y la garantía explica por qué la reparación es gratis.

pairs: The machine has been leaking since Tuesday.
An engineer can visit on Monday morning.
As agreed, the part will come by courier.
The warranty covers the repair.

pairs.es: motivo de que no se pague

prompt.es: Lee el hilo. ¿Qué solución se ha acordado hasta ahora?

choices.text: An engineer will inspect the fridge on Friday.
The fridge will be replaced with a new one on Friday.
The company will pay for the food that was lost.

feedback.es: Solo la visita del técnico el viernes está aceptada por ambas partes; la sustitución depende de la inspección y el gasto de la comida es una petición aún sin respuesta.

origin.text: Email 1: My fridge stopped working on 2 June, and all the food went bad. It is faulty and only six months old, so I expect a replacement, not a repair. Email 2: We are sorry to hear that. Our engineer can visit on Friday, but we cannot promise a replacement before he has inspected it. In the meantime, please do not switch the fridge off. Email 3: Friday is fine for me, although I am not happy about the wait. As a goodwill gesture, could you also cover the cost of the food?

prompt.es: ¿Qué da a entender el cliente con «although I am not happy about the wait»?

choices.text: He rejects the visit and prefers to wait for a replacement.
He accepts the visit but wants the company to know he is unhappy.
He is pleased with the answer and asks for nothing more.

feedback.es: «Friday is fine» acepta la visita, pero «although…» deja constancia de su malestar y prepara la petición de la comida.

origin.text: Email 1: My fridge stopped working on 2 June, and all the food went bad. It is faulty and only six months old, so I expect a replacement, not a repair. Email 2: We are sorry to hear that. Our engineer can visit on Friday, but we cannot promise a replacement before he has inspected it. In the meantime, please do not switch the fridge off. Email 3: Friday is fine for me, although I am not happy about the wait. As a goodwill gesture, could you also cover the cost of the food?

prompt.es: Completa: «Como el lunes es imposible, ¿podríamos reprogramar la visita?»

feedback.es: Reschedule + visita + for + nueva fecha es la colocación para cambiar una cita ya fijada.

origin.text: Monday is not possible for me because I am working away from home that day. Could we ___ the visit for Wednesday afternoon instead?

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje. ¿Con qué fin dice el técnico «in the meantime»?

choices.text: To explain why the repair is free of charge.
To ask the customer to reschedule the visit.
To avoid more damage until the part arrives.

feedback.es: «In the meantime» introduce lo que debe hacer el cliente hasta que llegue la pieza: no usar la máquina para evitar más daños.

origin.audio: Hello, this is Tom from customer support. The warranty covers the leak, so the visit will be free of charge. However, the part has to come from Germany, and, as promised, it will reach you by courier on Thursday. In the meantime, please keep the machine switched off, and do not use the kitchen sink.

prompt.es: Lee el correo. ¿Qué se espera de la clienta después de leerlo?

choices.text: That she confirms whether the new date suits her.
That she pays for the spare part on Thursday.
That she collects the part from the courier's office.

feedback.es: La empresa propone una nueva fecha y termina pidiendo que la clienta avise de si le conviene; la reparación sigue siendo gratuita y la pieza ya llegó.

origin.text: Dear Ms Green, unfortunately our engineer is ill tomorrow, so we would like to move your visit to Thursday at ten. The spare part has already arrived, and the repair remains free of charge under your warranty. Please let us know whether Thursday suits you.

prompt.es: Escucha el mensaje de la clienta. ¿Qué actitud deja ver?

choices.text: Angry, and determined to cancel the repair and ask for money back.
Polite, but unhappy that nobody warned her about the change.
Relaxed, since she does not mind the change of date.

feedback.es: Empieza con «I understand» y termina con «Could you please explain…»: es cortés, pero reprocha que nadie avisara del cambio.

origin.audio: I understand that the repair is covered, but nobody told me that the engineer only works in the mornings. As agreed on Monday, I expected the visit today, and I took the day off. Could you please explain why the visit was moved without telling me?

prompt.es: Ordena: «La pieza de repuesto tarda una semana en llegar.»

answer.text: The spare part takes a week to arrive

feedback.es: Take + tiempo + to + verbo expresa cuánto tarda algo en ocurrir.

title.en: Write a clear request or complaint
title.es: Redactar una petición o reclamo claro

es: Redactar un correo de reclamo a un servicio técnico que no respondió antes: referencia, problema, petición con plazo, consecuencia y cierre, con firmeza y cortesía.

teaching.en: I am writing again about my previous email of 2 June, to which I have still received no reply from your company.
teaching.es: Escribo de nuevo sobre mi correo anterior del 2 de junio, al que todavía no he recibido respuesta de su empresa.
teaching.explanationEs: La referencia abre el reclamo: recuerdas el correo anterior con fecha, sin reproche.
segments: I am writing again about my previous email of 2 June,
to which I have still received no reply from your company.
teaching.audioText: I am writing again about my previous email of 2 June, to which I have still received no reply from your company.

teaching.en: The heating has not worked for three weeks, which I find unacceptable, particularly as I have two young children at home.
teaching.es: La calefacción no funciona desde hace tres semanas, lo cual me parece inaceptable, sobre todo porque tengo dos niños pequeños en casa.
teaching.explanationEs: El problema va con un hecho y una fecha. Unacceptable es firme pero no insulta; particularly as explica por qué importa.
segments: The heating has not worked for three weeks, which I find
unacceptable, particularly as I have two young children at home.
teaching.audioText: The heating has not worked for three weeks, which I find unacceptable, particularly as I have two young children at home.

teaching.en: I apologise for any inconvenience this may cause, but I am entitled to a working heater, and I expect you to resolve the fault.
teaching.es: Pido disculpas por cualquier molestia que esto pueda causar, pero tengo derecho a un calentador que funcione y espero que resuelvan la avería.
teaching.explanationEs: La disculpa suaviza, pero but + be entitled to apoya la petición con un derecho. Resolve + objeto = dar solución.
segments: I apologise for any inconvenience this may cause, but I am entitled
to a working heater, and I expect you to resolve the fault.
teaching.audioText: I apologise for any inconvenience this may cause, but I am entitled to a working heater, and I expect you to resolve the fault.

teaching.en: Please confirm the date of the visit promptly, and note that I have enclosed a copy of my previous email for your records.
teaching.es: Por favor, confirme con prontitud la fecha de la visita y tenga en cuenta que adjunto una copia de mi correo anterior para sus registros.
teaching.explanationEs: Promptly pide rapidez; enclosed (o attached en correos) anuncia un documento que se adjunta.
segments: Please confirm the date of the visit promptly, and note that I
have enclosed a copy of my previous email for your records.
teaching.audioText: Please confirm the date of the visit promptly, and note that I have enclosed a copy of my previous email for your records.

teaching.en: Failing that, I will have to make a formal complaint to your manager, because no satisfactory solution has been offered so far.
teaching.es: De lo contrario, tendré que presentar una queja formal a su gerente, porque hasta ahora no se ha ofrecido ninguna solución satisfactoria.
teaching.explanationEs: Failing that anuncia la consecuencia cortés; la razón (no satisfactory solution) la justifica.
segments: Failing that, I will have to make a formal complaint to
your manager, because no satisfactory solution has been offered so far.
teaching.audioText: Failing that, I will have to make a formal complaint to your manager, because no satisfactory solution has been offered so far.

teaching.en: I trust that you will take this matter seriously, and I would welcome your assurance that an engineer will attend by Friday.
teaching.es: Confío en que tomará este asunto en serio y agradecería su garantía de que un técnico acudirá antes del viernes.
teaching.explanationEs: I trust that cierra con una expectativa, no con una súplica. Assurance es una promesa firme que pides por escrito.
segments: I trust that you will take this matter seriously, and I
would welcome your assurance that an engineer will attend by Friday.
teaching.audioText: I trust that you will take this matter seriously, and I would welcome your assurance that an engineer will attend by Friday.

prompt.es: Elige cómo empezar un segundo correo que recuerda el primero sin respuesta.

choices.text: I am writing to introduce myself, as we have not been in contact before.
I am writing again about my previous email, which has received no reply.
I am writing to thank you for your quick reply to my first email.

feedback.es: La referencia al correo anterior sin respuesta abre el reclamo; las otras opciones suponen un primer contacto o una respuesta que no existió.

hint.es: Empieza por recordar el mensaje anterior, que no tuvo respuesta.

origin.text: Sara wrote to a repair company on 2 June about a broken heater. Three weeks later, nobody has replied, and she is writing a second email.

prompt.es: Completa: «Este retraso es inaceptable, y debo pedirles que actúen.»

feedback.es: Unacceptable es el adjetivo firme para calificar un retraso sin insultar a nadie.

origin.text: The heating has been broken for three weeks, and I have two young children at home. This delay is ___, and I must ask you to act.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Por favor, resuelva el problema con prontitud y confirme la fecha.»

answer.text: Please resolve the problem promptly and confirm the date

feedback.es: Please resolve + objeto + promptly es la petición con urgencia cortés; and confirm añade una segunda acción.

hint.es: Empieza con please y deja la segunda acción para el final.

prompt.es: Escucha el borrador y elige qué consecuencia anuncia la clienta.

choices.text: A demand for a refund if the heater is not repaired soon.
A visit to the company's office if nobody answers her email.
A formal complaint if no engineer comes by the deadline.

feedback.es: «Failing that» anuncia la consecuencia: una queja formal al gerente si no llega un técnico antes del 12 de junio.

origin.audio: Dear Ms Gil, I am writing again about my previous email of 2 June, to which I have received no reply. The heating in my flat has not worked for three weeks, and I have two young children at home. I would be grateful if you could send an engineer by Friday 12 June. Failing that, I will make a formal complaint to your manager. I look forward to hearing from you.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase del correo con la parte que cumple.

pairs: The laptop has not worked since 3 May.

pairs.es: problema con un hecho y una fecha

pairs: Please send an engineer by Thursday.
Failing that, I will contact the director.
I look forward to hearing from you soon.

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una parte del correo: hecho con fecha, petición con plazo, consecuencia o cierre.

pairs: The laptop has not worked since 3 May.

pairs.es: problema con un hecho y una fecha

pairs: Please send an engineer by Thursday.
Failing that, I will contact the director.
I look forward to hearing from you soon.

prompt.es: Completa: «Confío en que responderá con prontitud.»

feedback.es: I trust that cierra el correo con la expectativa de una respuesta rápida, sin súplica.

origin.text: Thank you for your time and your attention to this matter. I ___ that you will reply promptly.

prompt.es: Escribe el correo: problema, petición con plazo, consecuencia y cierre.

answer.text: Dear Ms Gil, I am writing again about my previous email of 2 June, to which I have received no reply. The heating in my flat has not worked for three weeks, and as I have two young children at home, this situation is unacceptable. I apologise for any inconvenience this email may cause you, but I am entitled to a working heater, and I must ask you to resolve the fault promptly. I would be grateful if you could send an engineer no later than Friday 12 June and confirm the date of the visit in writing. I have enclosed a copy of my previous email so that you can see the details. Failing that, I will have to make a formal complaint to your manager, as I have not been offered any satisfactory solution so far. I trust that we can solve this matter quickly, and I would welcome your assurance that an engineer will attend. Thank you for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Leo Vega
accepted: Dear Ms Gil, I am writing again about my previous email of 2 June, to which I have received no reply. The heating in my flat has not worked for three weeks, and as I have two young children at home, this situation is unacceptable. I apologise for any inconvenience this email may cause you, but I am entitled to a working heater, and I must ask you to resolve the fault promptly. I would be grateful if you could send an engineer no later than Friday 12 June and confirm the date of the visit in writing. I have enclosed a copy of my previous email so that you can see the details. Failing that, I will have to make a formal complaint to your manager, as I have not been offered any satisfactory solution so far. I trust that we can solve this matter quickly, and I would welcome your assurance that an engineer will attend. Thank you for your help, and I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Leo Vega

Dear Ms Gil, I wrote to you on 2 June about the heating in my flat, but I have not had an answer. The heater has been broken for three weeks, and my two children are cold every night. I understand that you are busy, but I must remain firm: this situation is unacceptable. Could you kindly send an engineer before Friday 12 June? We are using two small electric heaters, and our electricity bill is already higher. I would also like to have the heater repaired during that visit, so that I do not need to ask again. Please confirm the date promptly. Failing that, I will make a formal complaint, and I will have to take the matter to your manager. I trust that you will solve this quickly, and I would appreciate a short reply today. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Leo Vega

feedback.es: Un buen reclamo recuerda el correo anterior, describe el problema con hechos, pide una acción con plazo, anuncia la consecuencia con cortesía y cierra con confianza en una respuesta.

origin.text: Hace tres semanas se estropeó la calefacción de tu piso. Escribiste a la empresa HomeFix el 2 de junio y nadie respondió. Escribe en inglés un correo de 190 a 240 palabras a la Sra. Gil: recuerda tu correo anterior, describe el problema con un hecho y una fecha (hay dos niños pequeños), pide un técnico antes del viernes 12 de junio, anuncia con cortesía una queja formal si no responden y cierra confiando en una respuesta pronta.

prompt.es: ¿Qué busca la clienta al pedir «a named contact»?

choices.text: One responsible person, so that she does not repeat her story.
A chance to complain in person about the engineer who failed to come.
A way to avoid paying for the next visit to her home.

feedback.es: Pide una persona concreta que confirme una fecha firme: así el caso no se pierde otra vez entre departamentos ni obliga a repetir lo ocurrido.

origin.text: Dear Mr Hale, I note that your engineer missed our appointment on Tuesday without any warning. I do not wish to exaggerate, but this is the third time in a month that I have had to take time off work. I would be grateful if you could give me a named contact who can confirm a firm date.

prompt.es: Completa: «Como cliente, tengo derecho a una reparación gratuita.»

feedback.es: Be entitled to + sustantivo expresa un derecho: apoya la petición con un argumento y no con un reproche.

origin.text: The heater was sold with a two-year guarantee, and it broke after only four months. As a customer, I am ___ to a free repair.

prompt.es: Elige la frase que fija un plazo con firmeza y cortesía.

choices.text: You have ignored me twice already, so repair the boiler by Friday or I will make you regret it.
I would be grateful if you could repair the boiler by Friday; failing that, I will complain formally.
It would be nice if the boiler could perhaps be repaired at some point in the coming weeks.

feedback.es: Fija una fecha, anuncia la consecuencia sin amenazar y mantiene la cortesía; las otras opciones amenazan o dejan el plazo abierto.

origin.text: Sara's landlord has promised to fix the boiler twice and has done nothing. She wants to give him one last clear deadline without being rude to him.

prompt.es: Lee este segundo correo. ¿Qué parte importante le falta?

choices.text: A clear deadline by which the engineer must come to the flat.
A polite consequence if nothing happens by then.
A reference to the earlier email that received no reply.

feedback.es: El correo tiene problema, plazo (by Friday), consecuencia y cierre; pero no recuerda ningún mensaje anterior, que es la referencia que abre un segundo correo.

origin.text: Dear Customer Service, my washing machine stopped working on 4 May, and two engineers have not come. Please send an engineer by Friday. Failing that, I will make a formal complaint. Thank you for your help.

prompt.es: Escucha. ¿Qué da a entender la clienta tras aceptar la disculpa?

choices.text: That an apology is not enough without a concrete action.
That she has accepted the situation and will not insist.
That she would prefer a refund to an engineer's visit.

feedback.es: Agradece la disculpa, pero dice que lo que necesita es una fecha: la disculpa por sí sola no resuelve nada.

origin.audio: Thank you for your apology, which I appreciate. However, the heating has still not been repaired, and my children have now been cold for nearly a month. An apology is welcome, but what I need is a date. Please confirm by Friday when the engineer will come.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Escribo de nuevo sobre mi correo anterior.»

answer.text: I am writing again about my previous email

feedback.es: About introduce el tema del mensaje anterior en la referencia del segundo correo.

title.es: Resolver un problema con un servicio

es: Resolver un caso de servicio completo: entender la respuesta de la empresa, redactar la petición final y aceptar, rechazar o negociar una contraoferta con firmeza y de buena fe.

teaching.en: The company has sent a counteroffer: a partial refund instead of a full one, which leaves the customer very little leeway.
teaching.es: La empresa ha enviado una contraoferta: un reembolso parcial en lugar de uno total, lo que deja muy poco margen de maniobra a la clienta.
teaching.explanationEs: Partial no es total: lee con qué límites ofrece la empresa. Leeway es el margen que queda para moverse.
segments: The company has sent a counteroffer: a partial refund instead of
a full one, which leaves the customer very little leeway.
teaching.audioText: The company has sent a counteroffer: a partial refund instead of a full one, which leaves the customer very little leeway.

teaching.en: I am afraid I must decline the offer as it stands, but I am writing in good faith, and I would like to negotiate.
teaching.es: Me temo que debo rechazar la oferta tal como está, pero escribo de buena fe y me gustaría negociar.
teaching.explanationEs: Decline rechaza con cortesía; in good faith muestra que no buscas el conflicto; negotiate abre la puerta a un acuerdo.
segments: I am afraid I must decline the offer as it stands, but
I am writing in good faith, and I would like to negotiate.
teaching.audioText: I am afraid I must decline the offer as it stands, but I am writing in good faith, and I would like to negotiate.

teaching.en: I am willing to settle for a partial refund, on the condition that you repair the machine by the end of the month.
teaching.es: Estoy dispuesto a conformarme con un reembolso parcial, con la condición de que repare la máquina antes de que acabe el mes.
teaching.explanationEs: Settle for + algo: aceptas menos de lo pedido. On the condition that va seguido de oración completa (sujeto + verbo).
segments: I am willing to settle for a partial refund, on the condition
that you repair the machine by the end of the month.
teaching.audioText: I am willing to settle for a partial refund, on the condition that you repair the machine by the end of the month.

teaching.en: To reach a compromise, I can meet you halfway: I will accept half the price now if the rest follows within six weeks.
teaching.es: Para llegar a un acuerdo a medias, puedo ceder la mitad: aceptaré la mitad del precio ahora si el resto llega en seis semanas.
teaching.explanationEs: Meet you halfway propone un punto medio; el compromise exige que ambas partes cedan algo.
segments: To reach a compromise, I can meet you halfway: I will accept
half the price now if the rest follows within six weeks.
teaching.audioText: To reach a compromise, I can meet you halfway: I will accept half the price now if the rest follows within six weeks.

teaching.en: Under the circumstances, your counteroffer seems fair, although I would like to propose one small change to the delivery date.
teaching.es: Dadas las circunstancias, su contraoferta me parece justa, aunque me gustaría proponer un pequeño cambio en la fecha de entrega.
teaching.explanationEs: Under the circumstances reconoce el contexto antes de matizar; although introduce el único cambio que pides.
segments: Under the circumstances, your counteroffer seems fair, although I would
like to propose one small change to the delivery date.
teaching.audioText: Under the circumstances, your counteroffer seems fair, although I would like to propose one small change to the delivery date.

teaching.en: We accept your counteroffer in full, so please consider the matter closed and confirm the refund in writing.
teaching.es: Aceptamos su contraoferta por completo, así que considere el asunto cerrado y confirme el reembolso por escrito.
teaching.explanationEs: In full significa «por completo»: aceptas todos los términos. Pedir confirmación por escrito evita malentendidos.
segments: We accept your counteroffer in full, so please consider
the matter closed and confirm the refund in writing.
teaching.audioText: We accept your counteroffer in full, so please consider the matter closed and confirm the refund in writing.

prompt.es: Elige qué ofrece la tienda en esta contraoferta.

choices.text: A full refund, but no repair of the machine itself.
A free repair, but no money returned at all.
A partial refund together with a free repair.

feedback.es: La tienda devuelve la mitad del precio (reembolso parcial) y repara gratis; no ofrece reembolso total ni deja de devolver dinero.

hint.es: Fíjate en cuánto dinero devuelven y qué más ofrecen.

origin.text: Dear Ms Reyes, we cannot refund the full price, but we can refund half of it and repair the machine free of charge next week. We hope that this seems fair to you.

prompt.es: Completa: «Lamento tener que rechazar esa oferta.»

feedback.es: I am afraid I must decline es el rechazo cortés de una oferta, con el motivo a continuación.

hint.es: Es el verbo que se usa para rechazar con cortesía.

origin.text: The company has offered a small discount on my next order. I am afraid I must ___ that offer, because it does not cover the cost of the repair.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me conformaré con un reembolso parcial.»

answer.text: I will settle for a partial refund

feedback.es: Settle for + algo expresa que aceptas una solución menor a la pedida: aquí, un reembolso parcial.

hint.es: Usa settle for antes del reembolso.

prompt.es: Escucha la historia y elige qué condición pone Tom a su propuesta.

choices.text: That he is given a spare laptop while he waits.
That the repair is finished within a single working week.
That he also receives half of his money back.

feedback.es: Tom acepta la reparación con la condición de que la empresa le dé un portátil de sustitución mientras tanto; no pide una reparación más rápida ni el reembolso.

origin.audio: Tom's laptop broke down after four weeks. The company offered him either half of his money back or a repair in three weeks, but not both. Tom thanked them for the counteroffer, explained that he needed the laptop for work, and proposed a compromise: he would settle for the repair, on the condition that the company gave him a spare laptop in the meantime. The company accepted, and they agreed that Tom would receive the spare laptop on Friday.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con la decisión que expresa.

pairs: I am happy to accept your offer.
I am afraid I cannot agree to that.
I would like to propose a small change to your offer.
I will agree only if the repair is free.

feedback.es: Cada frase expresa una decisión distinta ante una contraoferta: aceptar, rechazar, negociar un cambio o poner una condición.

pairs: I am happy to accept your offer.
I am afraid I cannot agree to that.
I would like to propose a small change to your offer.
I will agree only if the repair is free.

prompt.es: ¿Qué actitud muestra el cliente hacia la contraoferta?

choices.text: Against it, and ready to reject everything in it.
Open to it, but wanting to improve one detail.
Not interested in it, and happy with any date.

feedback.es: Acepta el reembolso parcial como razonable, pero «However…» pide negociar la fecha de entrega: apertura con una mejora concreta.

origin.text: Thank you for the counteroffer. Under the circumstances, it seems reasonable, and I am willing to accept a partial refund. However, I would like to negotiate the delivery date, as three weeks is too long for me.

prompt.es: Escribe tu respuesta final: rechaza, propón un acuerdo con condición y fija plazo.

answer.text: Dear Ms Lee, thank you for your reply and for your counteroffer. I appreciate that you have looked carefully at my case, and I am writing in good faith. I am afraid I must decline both options as they stand. A refund of half the price would not cover a new laptop, and a repair in three weeks is too long, because I need the laptop for my work. However, I would like to propose a compromise. I am willing to settle for the repair, on the condition that it is finished by Friday 26 June and that you give me another laptop until then. Under the circumstances, I would also be grateful for a discount on the repair, as the delay has caused me a great deal of inconvenience. I understand that this may be difficult, so I am happy to meet you halfway on the discount. Please confirm your decision by Monday, and I will consider the matter closed once the laptop is back with me. Failing that, I will have to escalate my case to your manager.
